entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I hope you can help. I feel awful about this, but I need to return something I bought a little while ago. It's a helmet.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, is there a technical fault with the helmet, or is this more of a preference issue?

Oh, there's nothing wrong with it at all. In fact, the box is still unopened. I just... I bought it for my partner but the color wasn't quite right, and then we just never got around to dealing with it. I've been a loyal customer for years and I'd really appreciate getting the money back.
I understand. Let me just pull up your account to check the purchase date. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-0215. I know it's been a while, and with everything going on, I just really need the refund. I hope it's not too late.
Thank you for that. One moment while I review your order... Okay, I see the helmet was delivered 85 days ago.
Oh, is that... is that too long? I was really counting on this.

Not at all. According to our policy for standard items, you're well within the 90-day return window. Since the box is unopened, and it's a crucial piece of safety equipment, we can absolutely process that return for you.
Really? Oh, thank you so much, Isaac! That is such a relief. You have no idea.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could help. I've just initiated the return in our system and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, you can expect a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you again for being so understanding.
Of course. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
